rationale: On a held step, the Chd3 decrement (channel_edit_page_ui.lua:1319-1326) called memory.record_event at once instead of adding a recorder portion committed on release, as every other mask handler does. The missing song_pattern had no visible effect (record_event falls back to the selected song pattern, and the recorder drops the portion's top-level song_pattern for the other handlers too); the bypass did: turning Chd3 up and then back down in one hold wrote the decrement immediately, then the release committed the still-pending increment portion over it, so the step sounded the value before the decrement (67 instead of the selected 65) and the hold was remembered as two actions. The decrement now adds the same recorder portion as the other handlers.
oracle: README 601: hold the desired step and select each note you want to include in the chord (the selected value sounds). README 698-707: memory retains mask actions, each shown as an icon. Human decision 2026-09-11 on S25: match the other handlers; the one-action count is characterisation of the Chd4 control.
